name: lorenzini
description: Three Claude Code skills that wait for a third-party pull-request reviewer and adjudicate whether its verdict actually means pass. They do not review code; they decide what the reviewer said about it.

plugins.name: lorenzini
plugins.description: Installs coderabbit-review-wait, copilot-review-wait and codex-review-wait. Pick the one that covers the repository you are in; the three define a clean pass differently.
